title: Exact native connection.offer fields and source authority
implementation: Existing production native coordinator already materializes the selected offer contract. This change adds actual request/answer correlation, signed callback observation, explicit authority-refusal and no-effect assertions. No runtime, API, schema, compatibility or downgrade path is changed.

schema_validation.scope: Local Connect native QUIC/public SDK actual offer fields, signed prepared setup, current capability selection, physical/participant authority refusals without effects and independent decoded duplex recovery. No other positive substrate or complete task/acceptance claim.

verification.current_audio_recovery: Independent FFmpeg G.711 decoding succeeds in both directions after all refusals; exactly2 actual native Connections remain.

assertions: Actual public SDK commands create/invite/accept the Session and negotiate two real peer Connections. Captured initial request payloads explicitly name each current actual Participant, quic substrate, capabilities, logical Stream, audio/sendrecv direction and ordered codec preferences.

Four actual signed server callback connection.offer frames include the exact authenticated Participant and canonical CID/SID/Connection/operation, current capabilities, selected stream preferences and real native-prepared/1 substrate setup. Each prepared logical Stream/codec/physical handle matches its offered Stream.

Each actual signed answer correlates the exact SDK-returned request ID; callback operation IDs preserve the original logical operation. Both signed callback and answer envelopes validate against the unchanged full frozen schema2.

The current Session permits only PCMU. Offered PCMA-first preferences select mutual PCMU, and advertised callback capabilities contain only current allowed PCMU. A PCMA-only offer returns a failed operation and creates zero effects.

A same-Conversation foreign Participant cannot be claimed as the source: the actual server returns signed403/auth. A WebTransport claim on this actual QUIC peer returns signed501/unsupported. Both have the exact request correlation and zero durable effects. Reliable barriers remain usable.
Actual current decoded duplex audio and the2 live bindings survive all three refusal classes. The existing codec/foreign-physical/replay regression also passes against the same current executable.
scope: Selected local macOS arm64 Connect production native QUIC/public signed SDK profile, with both signing algorithms. No injected Session/Connection rows establish the positive lifecycle. Provisioning installs controlled credentials and the local endpoint.
intermediate_checks: The first capture-only run passed both algorithms and showed complete actual signed offer fields. The expanded authority run passed before tightening403/501 assertions; repeated scenes are not extra method/profile credit.

An initial payload-only validator incorrectly merged envelope-root required-v constraints with a payload ref. Corrected to standalone $defs/$ref without changing the contract; full signed frames retain strict envelope validation. This was a harness error, not a runtime wire failure.
limits: 58/61 auxiliary clauses qualified; remaining0112/0113/0123. G6-046 remains in progress,45/105 tasks complete, and the full105-task objective remains active.

No positive WebTransport/WSS/WebRTC/SIP offer/profile qualification is inferred from a rejected mismatched substrate; those later transport/hosting/remote/independent acceptance profiles remain separately assigned.
No broad capacity, loss/performance, received-source retention/redaction, general gateway completion, acceptance or publication claim.
